name: Golf
howTo:
Get the lowest score over 9 rounds.

# Setup
- Each player gets a 2×2 grid face down; one card starts the discard pile.
- At the start, peek at two of your cards (tap a card, then Peek).

# Your turn
- Draw from the deck or take the top discard.
- Swap it with any card in your grid (the new card lands face up; the old card goes to the discard), or discard it.
- To turn one of your face-down cards up, tap it, then Flip.

# Ending a round
- The round ends when every player's cards are face up. The dealer then gets a "Round looks over" prompt: tap Score it (or End Round).

# Scoring
- A = 1, 2 to 10 face value, 5 = -5, J and Q = 10, K = 0.
- Two or more cards of the same rank anywhere in your grid all score 0.
- Lowest total after 9 rounds wins.
